<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: ui-projects-need-test-infrastructure -->
**Ui Projects Need Test Infrastructure:** JavaScript/React projects consistently lack test infrastructure. 84% of
flavor-network iterations had no test coverage. mod-my-week-platform had 0%
test involvement and was the ONLY project with gate failures (3 failures on
audit/refactoring tasks).
Observed in: flavor-network (84% test gap), mod-my-week-platform (0% tests, 3 gate failures), EventDesignedLearning (inconsistent)
  Fix: 1. Bootstrap test infrastructure (jest, react-testing-library) in project setup phase
2. Add test-writing as first-class task category in plan.md
3. Gate should warn (not block) when source files change without corresponding test files
4. Template test suites for common patterns (component rendering, API calls, state management)

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: file-failure-home-spec-ts-ka-site -->
**File Failure Home Spec Ts Ka Site:** home.spec.ts has a 67% gate failure rate (2.0/3.0 iterations)

Failing gate checks: `manager_review_unknown` (2x), `tests` (1x).

Top error signatures:
- (1x) RUN v4.1.5 KA_Site
- (1x) No test files found, exiting with code 1
- (1x) filter: src/

Frequently co-changed files: `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `blind_tdd_audit.py`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `vitest.config.ts`.

Recent failing commits:
- 2026-04-29 (KA_Site) — checks: manager_review_unknown
- 2026-04-29 (KA_Site) — checks: tests, manager_review_unknown | RUN v4.1.5 KA_Site

Observed in: KA_Site
  Fix: 1. Manager review keeps rejecting changes here. Read the most recent review verdicts from the dashboard and address the cited concerns before retrying.
2. Reproduce the dominant error first: `RUN v4.1.5 KA_Site` (seen 1x). If your change doesn't address it, expect the gate to fail again.
3. Changes here usually touch `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `blind_tdd_audit.py`. Either inspect those files for shared state, or split the commit so a single boundary fails per gate run.
4. After applying any of the above, tag the commit message with `<lesson_applied stem='file-failure-home-spec-ts-ka-site' how='N' />` where N is the step you used. This is how the corpus learns whether the lesson is actually working (see docs/bridge-protocol.md §4h).
